description: This file is a C header (.h) that declares memory-related functions and macros for the rt-loader component in an embedded or kernel development context. It includes function prototypes for memory management utilities, cache operations, and some macros for hardware register access.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes a specified memory range from cache, likely to ensure data coherency.

methods.name: malloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Moves a block of memory, supporting overlapping regions.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory from source to destination.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specific byte value.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a null-terminated string.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Computes CRC32 checksum over a memory block.
